slot.brief: Give a standard y(x,t) sinusoidal equation; ask for amplitude, wavelength, frequency or wave speed by comparing with the standard form.

stem: A transverse wave on a rope is described by $y(x,t)=0.04\sin(2\pi x-18\pi t)$, where $x$ and $y$ are in m and $t$ is in s. What is its frequency?

verdicts.working: Comparing with y=A sin(kx−ωt), ω=18π rad/s. Thus f=ω/(2π)=9 Hz.

working:
$\omega=18\pi\ \text{rad s}^{-1}$
$f=\dfrac{\omega}{2\pi}=\dfrac{18\pi}{2\pi}=9\ \text{Hz}$

Independent check: Comparing with y=A sin(kx−ωt), ω=18π rad/s. Thus f=ω/(2π)=9 Hz.
solution:
Comparing $y=0.04\sin(2\pi x-18\pi t)$ with $y=A\sin(kx-\omega t)$, we get $\omega=18\pi\,\text{rad s}^{-1}$.
$$f=\frac{\omega}{2\pi}=\frac{18\pi}{2\pi}=9\,\text{Hz}$$
